definitions.return_delta_pp: mean over four fixed episodes: 100 * (target - reference return)
definitions.cost: USD/window mean and four-window sum; already deducted in net return
definitions.invalid_rate: invalid / observed requests, including retries in denominator
definitions.coverage: number/list of actually filled symbols; unspecified universe denominator
definitions.concentration: peak single-position weight, mean final position count, mean final cash/equity; fill-count Top1/HHI describe trading count concentration, not portfolio value HHI
definitions.std_eta_S: logged std_S is already eta-scaled; do not multiply by eta again
definitions.raw_S: pooled S reconstructed as std_S/eta for M2 eta>0; M1 raw S unavailable
definitions.nonzero_S: effective S at logged tolerance; not reconstructed raw nonzero rate
definitions.critic_fit: same real rows/targets pre/post update; first-token value per step

limits: Repeated four-window Train evaluation; no OOS or independent sample claim.
Every fixed point retained; partial pairs never become a four-window mean or zero.
Training windows/trajectories differ by round/arm; training return is not a curve.
Reconstructed raw S is per observed batch; different eta arms can have different S.
